answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks through hardware-bound inference attestation. Each node must complete interactive multimodal tasks, such as parsing an acoustic sonnet alongside imagery of a vine against a sable backdrop. Meeting strict latency deadlines forces an adversary to commit scarce, unshared accelerator memory and tensor cores per identity, preventing cheap virtualization. However, network jitter can delay valid responses, falsely rejecting honest agents.
